name: Gantry
desc: A descent through a dark industrial volume laced with steel catwalks — grated decks and handrails cross the void at a dozen depths and rise past the eye as the camera sinks, clamped work lamps bloom in the haze, and a shaft of light leans through the corrugated dark.

energy.doc: lamp output, light-shaft strength, camera drift and descent rate

scale.doc: deck width, rail height and level pitch (2.2 = colossal gantries; the volume's Z depth stays fixed so this is never a no-op)

density.doc: how many levels of catwalk lace the void

hue.doc: steel hue; lamps take its complement

lamps.doc: how many work lamps are clamped to the rails (0 = the plant is dead and unlit)

style.doc: aesthetic: cold galvanised steel / oxidised decay / amber sodium night / cyan schematic linework / false-colour thermal

seed.doc: catwalk runs, orientations, lamp placement, corrosion (absolute-level keyed, so the descent never repeats)
